messages:
Sam K: Heads up — cutoff for this release is tomorrow 17:00 PT. If you haven't added a changelog entry, please file one now. Keep entries short and follow the template below. I’ll sweep PRs at 16:30. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Mia P: Got it. Quick q: do breaking changes need explicit migration steps in the entry or link to the PR? @Sam K
Sam K: Prefer short note + link. Example: "DB: change X — requires migration Y (see PR #1234)". If it's complex, add a one-line summary and link to the release note doc.
Chris L: Who's taking version bump? I can do the bump + tag if someone reviews the changelog before merge.
Tay: @Chris L I'll review changelog entries—ping me when ready. I'll also run the release checklist.
Diana (release-qa): A couple of format nits I've been seeing: 1) no multi-paragraph entries, 2) always include component tag, 3) use present tense. I'll paste the compact template.
Diana (release-qa): ```
- [component] Short, imperative summary. (impact) — optional link
Example: - auth: tighten token TTL handling. (minor)
``` 
Sam K: Also: if a PR touches multiple components, pick the main component and add secondary in parens. Don't duplicate entries across PRs.
Chris L: There's a backport for #3412 — is there an owner for 2.1.x? @Mia P?
Mia P: I can own 2.1.x backport review today afternoon.
deploy-bot: Deploy reminder: release branch cut will trigger autoscale. See /releases for details.
Tay: Mini checklist before cut: changelog entries ✅, version bump PR ✅, smoke test plan in PR body ✅, release notes draft updated ✅.
Chris L: I'll open bump PR in 20m and tag @Tay and @Diana
Sam K: If anyone needs exemption from cutoff, DM me with the risk/rollback plan. Otherwise assume freeze after 17:00 PT.
Diana (release-qa): Quick lint I run locally:
```bash
cat CHANGELOG.md | rg "^- \[" || true
# ensures entries have component brackets
```
Mia P: thanks — will use that. Also left a tiny phrasing nit on #4567 changelog entry.
Chris L: PR opened: #4789 — bump to v1.8.2, changelog + smoke steps in body. @Tay @Diana can you take a look?
Tay: Reviewing now. Quick heads-up: please squash the 'WIP' commits.
Sam K: Thx team. I'll do the final sweep at 16:30 and merge bump if everything green. :rocket:
